skills.title: Programming Fundamentals
skills.summary: Control flow, functions, data structures and the mental model of a running program.
learning_objectives: Trace program state through control flow, function calls and mutation.
Choose basic data structures by their access patterns.
Reason about time complexity of simple algorithms.

beginner.objective: Predict the output of short programs with loops and functions.
beginner.competency: Correctly traces program output on at least two distinct questions in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Explain aliasing, recursion and complexity trade-offs.
intermediate.competency: Explains complexity and state changes correctly on at least two distinct questions in separate sessions.

advanced.objective: Select and justify structures for non-trivial problems.
advanced.competency: Justifies data-structure choices with correct complexity analysis in at least two independent attempts.

skills.title: Python
skills.summary: The data model, scope, mutability and concurrency behaviour behind everyday Python.
learning_objectives: Predict behaviour driven by object identity, mutability and scope.
Explain late binding, default arguments and copying semantics.
Choose threads, processes or asyncio for a workload.

beginner.objective: Distinguish identity from equality and spot shared mutable defaults.
beginner.competency: Answers at least two distinct beginner questions correctly across separate sessions, one of them objectively graded.

intermediate.objective: Explain closures, scope and copy semantics precisely.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions across separate sessions with evidence-backed reasoning.

advanced.objective: Match concurrency models to workloads and justify the choice.
advanced.competency: Gives evidence-backed concurrency designs in at least two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: TypeScript
skills.summary: TypeScript and JavaScript: narrowing, generics, unions and runtime boundaries.
learning_objectives: Use narrowing and discriminated unions to model state safely.
Write constrained generics with correct inferred types.
Explain what types guarantee at runtime and validate external data.

beginner.objective: Narrow unions and distinguish unknown from any.
beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Model states with unions and reason about generic inference.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions with evidence-backed reasoning.

advanced.competency: Proposes runtime validation designs in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: HTTP
skills.summary: HTTP and API engineering: semantics, status codes, caching and browser security.
learning_objectives: Apply method semantics and status codes correctly.
Design cache behaviour for public and personalised responses.
Explain CORS and design retry-safe APIs.

beginner.objective: Choose correct methods and status codes.
beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Design caching and explain preflight behaviour.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions with evidence-backed reasoning.

advanced.competency: Designs idempotency mechanisms in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: SQL
skills.summary: PostgreSQL and database engineering: querying, indexing and transactions.
learning_objectives: Write queries with correct NULL and join semantics.
Choose indexes from access patterns and read query plans.
Reason about isolation levels and concurrent writes.

beginner.objective: Apply three-valued logic and outer join semantics.
beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Reason about composite indexes and lost updates.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions with evidence-backed reasoning.

advanced.objective: Diagnose planner decisions and fix them.
advanced.competency: Diagnoses plan problems correctly in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: React
skills.summary: React and Next.js: state as a snapshot, identity, effects and data fetching.
learning_objectives: Predict rendering from state snapshots and keys.
Use effects only for synchronisation, with correct dependencies.
Fetch data without race conditions.

beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Diagnose effect dependencies and derived state.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions with evidence-backed reasoning.

advanced.competency: Implements race-free fetching in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: FastAPI
skills.summary: FastAPI and backend development: validation, dependencies and async handlers.
learning_objectives: Use type-driven validation and response models safely.
Design dependency graphs with correct lifetimes.
Keep async handlers non-blocking.

beginner.objective: Predict validation behaviour and filter responses.
beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Reason about dependency caching and the event loop.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions in separate sessions.

advanced.competency: Designs request-scoped resources correctly in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: Testing
skills.summary: Testing and debugging: test design, test doubles and reliable suites.
learning_objectives: Choose test cases from boundaries and failure modes.
Use fixtures and mocks correctly.
Diagnose and fix flaky tests methodically.

beginner.objective: Design basic test cases and use fixtures.
beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions in separate sessions.

advanced.objective: Design a test strategy around real dependencies.
advanced.competency: Produces evidence-backed test strategies in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: Security
skills.summary: Web and application security: authentication, authorisation, injection and secrets.
learning_objectives: Distinguish authentication from authorisation and enforce both.
Prevent injection and cross-site attacks.
Handle secrets and sensitive data safely.

beginner.competency: Correctly identifies vulnerabilities on two distinct questions in separate sessions.

intermediate.competency: Applies correct mitigations on two distinct questions in separate sessions.

advanced.competency: Produces evidence-backed threat models in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: DevOps
skills.summary: DevOps and cloud: CI/CD, containers, observability and safe rollouts.
learning_objectives: Build reproducible pipelines and container images.
Instrument services with logs, metrics and traces.
Roll out and roll back changes safely.

beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions in separate sessions.

advanced.objective: Plan progressive delivery with rollback criteria.
advanced.competency: Designs safe rollouts in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: System Design
skills.summary: Scaling, caching, failure handling and the trade-offs between them.
learning_objectives: Estimate capacity from stated assumptions.
Design caching with explicit staleness bounds.
Handle failure with timeouts, retries and backpressure.

beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions in separate sessions.

advanced.competency: Designs invalidation strategies in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: Distributed Systems
skills.summary: Consistency, consensus, messaging and partial failure across machines.
learning_objectives: Explain consistency models and their trade-offs.
Design reliable messaging with idempotent consumers.
Reason about partitions, clocks and ordering.

beginner.objective: Describe partial failure and at-least-once delivery.
beginner.competency: Answers two distinct beginner questions correctly in separate sessions.

intermediate.objective: Choose consistency guarantees for a feature.
intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions in separate sessions.

advanced.competency: Produces evidence-backed designs in two independent attempts on different days.

skills.title: Senior Engineering Practices
skills.summary: Code review, technical decision-making, incident response and mentoring.
learning_objectives: Review changes for risk, not style.
Write and defend technical decisions with trade-offs.
Lead incident response and blameless follow-up.

beginner.competency: Identifies risk correctly on two distinct questions in separate sessions.

intermediate.competency: Succeeds on two distinct intermediate questions in separate sessions.

advanced.objective: Lead an incident from detection to follow-up.
advanced.competency: Produces evidence-backed incident plans in two independent attempts on different days.
